thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Severity: high — Elevated 5xx and timeouts observed across API gateway. Potential quota/rate-limit cascade. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/quota-cascade

oncall-sre: acked. I'm on it. paging oncall-sre@infra (me).

maria: seeing spike in 5xx from gateway v2 -> 5xx-rate-limit-error and 502s. Dashboards spiking since ~+6m. Customer-facing errors starting to show.

ajay: logs look like 'rate_limit_exceeded' followed by gateway upstream 502s. Could be quota service hitting limits and cascading to backend.

devon: stacktrace sample from gateway: ```
2026-03-15T10:12:01Z ERROR upstream request failed status=502 code=RL-429 cascade=true
```

jamie: adding runbook link to thread. Also I see tenant token bleed in quota-service metrics for tenant=acme-corp, tokens_burn=94% window=1m.

oncall-sre: quick check: is there a recent config change to global throttle or quota assignment? ops-bot, any deploys?

ops-bot: Deploy event: services/quota-service rolled out at 10:08 UTC (deploy-id: deploy-2026-03-15-1008). No automated rollback.

leo: ok if deploy correlated, we should rollback throttle changes asap. Can someone run `kubectl rollout undo` on quota-service?

maria: running quick mitigation: bump tenant hard quota for acme-corp to 5x for 15m and enable fail-open for quota checks. Command: ```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/tenants/acme-corp/quota -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"override": {"requests_per_min": 50000}}'
```

ajay: i'm patching gateway to route acme-corp traffic to fallback/low-cost-path to avoid overloaded inference pool. `route: fallback:true` in policy.

oncall-sre: applying temporary global throttling relaxation: update rate-limiter config to allow burst=2000 for 5m. Pushing now.

devon: after acme bump + gateway route, 5xx dropped from 18% -> 3% for acme requests. Overall still 7% due to other tenants.

jamie: for other tenants, quota-service shows a hot partition in redis cluster shard-7 causing high latency and timeouts which lead to upstream 502s. Need to evict heavy keys or failover shard.

leo: initiating redis shard failover: `redis-cli -h shard-7 SLAVEOF NO ONE` then promote. ETA ~90s.

ops-bot: redis failover started (ops-run-778). Monitoring.

maria: while failover runs, enabling prefix caching at gateway for small prompt paths to reduce quota-service calls: `cache-prefix: true` policy applied.

customer-success: Heads up — CS is drafting a message for affected customers. We need impact matrix: which customers saw >5% error rate, timeframe, estimated requests impacted.

ajay: pulling query: ```
SELECT tenant, count(*) as errors FROM request_logs WHERE status >= 500 AND ts > now() - interval '15 minutes' GROUP BY tenant ORDER BY errors DESC LIMIT 20;
```

ajay: top-3: acme-corp (12.3k errors), beta-inc (4.1k), gamma-llc (1.2k). Total errors ~18.1k in last 15m.

oncall-sre: good. CS: say target tenants acme-corp, beta-inc, gamma-llc. Message: short outage + mitigations + contact for postmortem.

devon: redis failover completed. latency for quota-service reduced from 800ms -> 60ms median. 5xx overall dropping to 1.5%.

jamie: confirm we also reverted the problematic deploy? who rolled back quota-service?

leo: i did an automated rollback to deploy-2026-03-14-2210 at 10:25 UTC. rollback succeeded.

ops-bot: Rollback event logged: deploy-2026-03-15-1008 -> rollback to deploy-2026-03-14-2210.

maria: closing the temporary tenant override in 10m. Keep metrics observed for 30m.

oncall-sre: actions summary (will paste to incident tracker):
- acked and paged at 10:09 UTC
- applied tenant override for acme-corp at 10:14 UTC (bumped RPS)
- applied gateway fallback routing for acme-corp at 10:15 UTC
- enabled temporary rate-limiter burst relax at 10:16 UTC
- initiated redis shard-7 failover at 10:18 UTC
- rolled back quota-service deploy at 10:25 UTC
- monitored stabilization; 5xx reduced to <2% by 10:28 UTC

jamie: timeline looks good. I'll open a post-incident ticket and link runbook steps + config diff. We should also add circuit-breaker to prevent single-tenant quota spikes taking down the global gateway.

devon: quick note: add isolate-tenant routing to prod gateways (policy: max-tenants-per-pool) and enable early 429s with clear retry-after to avoid cascade.

customer-success: sending initial customer note now: "We observed intermittent elevated errors impacting requests for several customers between 10:08-10:28 UTC. We have applied mitigations and services are healthy. We will follow up with a postmortem." :email:

oncall-sre: marking incident as mitigated at 10:28 UTC. Leaving monitoring for 60m and then handoff to oncall-sre-non-urgent for postmortem actions.

maria: filing config diff and the command history: `curl`, `kubectl`, `redis-cli` snippets saved in /incidents/5043210000/artifacts.

ajay: follow-ups: add automated rate-limit canary test on deploys, monitor redis partitioning alerts, and add per-tenant isolation knobs in runbook.

leo: ack. I'll draft the engineering action items and assign owners.

ops-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) by oncall-sre at 10:28 UTC. Postmortem owner: jamie.

jamie: thanks all. reactions: :thumbsup: :coffee:
